overall_assessment: All 28 packet courses were reviewed, including all four suspects; no personal-data leaks, content over-removal, or anonymization-induced corruption were found in the displayed material. The name_like flags are false alarms involving reference authors and titles in HIST1100, repertoire/composer names and titles in PNOS5100, Ole Bull Akademiet in HIST2100, and Høyskolen Barratt Due in KKOR5100. One random control retains an administrative quality-system validity range; recurring yearless submission deadlines are explicitly retained pending a decision in R/anonymize.R, and the packet-truncated DID1/DID2 text was reviewed in full as displayed.

findings.evidence: Emnet evalueres i henhold til Kvalitetssikringssystem for Høyskolen Barratt Due 2023-2027
findings.description: PED2 retains the institution quality-system validity range 2023-2027 in its evaluation clause (1 of 28 reviewed courses). This dates an internal administrative policy, rather than course subject matter, a literature publication, or a government document, and should be removed under the administrative-dating rubric. The pre-pass did not flag it.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R has no barrattdue-specific handler. The generic year-range replacement delegates to .drop_academic_year(), which removes only consecutive years, so the four-year internal quality-system validity range survives; the administrative-keyword rules also do not cover this context.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a barrattdue handler in R/anonymize.R that removes a trailing YYYY-YYYY validity range specifically from lines naming the institution Kvalitetssikringssystem, preserving the evaluation clause and institution name. Add a regression case for this exact line and a preservation case for historical content ranges such as 1800-2000.
